data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence (DEALS, Deals & Promotions, open the region dropdown, select the region) with region as the parameter, but it names the dropdown differently from the true "All Regions" control, and its final step is generic instead of specifying the region value, so it is slightly vaguer than the true workflow.
